_scope: Two categories. A = threat actors USING AI to attack (MITRE ATT&CK + LLM-TTP taxonomy, Appendix A). B = threat actors ATTACKING AI systems (MITRE ATLAS). Both require confirmed, in-the-wild, attributed activity — never researcher/vendor proof-of-concept. See docs/Collection-Pipeline-Design.md.

trusted_sources._comment: Domains that BYPASS the skeptic gate (still deduped + bias-flagged). Everything else is scrutinized. Match is by substring on the source host. Covers both Category A and B reporters.

spam_denylist._comment: Optional: pure SEO/aggregator hosts to exclude at retrieval. Keep short; retrieval is otherwise a wide net.

recurring_trackers_to_enumerate_every_ru: Google GTIG AI Threat Tracker (multiple editions/year)
MITRE ATLAS case studies (atlas.mitre.org/studies) — Category B real-world incidents
